subject: SIG evidence collection: Lumenix Health RFP — control mapping & artifacts
messages:
From: Sarah Nolan <sarah@lumenixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumenixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-01-11T16:18:00-08:00
Subject: RFP - Security controls evidence (initial ask)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As part of our RFP intake we need a mapping of Redwood's controls to SIG+SOC 2. Specifically we need: 1) a CSV/XLS crosswalk (control id -> Redwood control / artifact), 2) samples of logs showing key rotation events, and 3) an answer on whether production telemetry is retained for 12 months. Can you confirm who will be owning the artifact delivery and an ETA? We have an internal deadline of Feb 10 to get the packet to our compliance team.

Best,
Sarah Nolan
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Lumenix Health

Attachments: rfp_intro.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah@lumenixhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-14T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFP - Security controls evidence (initial ask)

Thanks Sarah — we can do that. Short plan:

- Kimberly will own the control crosswalk and will share a first draft XLS by Jan 21.
- Sergio will gather key rotation logs and a short provenance note (we'll redact customer-specific keys).
- I'll coordinate telemetry retention detail and confirm retention windows for production traces/stats.

ETA: initial package sent by Jan 22; final curated packet by Feb 5 to meet your Feb 10 internal deadline.

Do you have any specific format or templates we should use for the crosswalk? Also confirm if the SOC 2 attestation PDF is sufficient for the attestation slot, or do you need the SysTrust-style appendix as well.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_delivery_timeline.csv (text/csv)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sarah Nolan <sarah@lumenixhealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-21T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Draft control crosswalk and evidence plan

Sarah — attaching a draft crosswalk (see sheet 'Mapping v1') with suggested artifact names. Notes:

- Control grouping follows SIG domain names; where controls map to SOC 2 criteria we've added the SOC column.
- For KMS/key rotation we can provide a redacted event log (proof_of_encryption.log) and a short statement describing automation (attached kms-key-provenance.pdf).
- Production telemetry retention: standard logs (ingestion + runtime telemetry) are retained 90 days by default; we offer a 12-month retention addon and can produce an export for compliance if requested. That option is called 'Retention Tier-12' in pricing and needs a short provisioning lead time (~7 business days) for long-term storage activation.

Questions for Sarah: would you like the redaction performed by Redwood or would you prefer to receive raw artifacts and we can provide a redaction script? Also confirm whether you want sample logs for the last 6 months or a rolling 12-month sample.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sarah Nolan <sarah@lumenixhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumenixhealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-02T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft control crosswalk and evidence plan

Thanks — this looks good and addresses most of our asks. A couple of follow-ups before we mark the packet complete:

- Please provide the redacted KMS rotation events for the last 12 months (rolling 12). Redaction by Redwood is preferred.
- Provide a short confirmed statement (one paragraph) that outlines where telemetry is stored and the SLA/process for retention upgrades (we will include this in our RFP appendix).
- Please upload the final crosswalk + artifacts to the Drive link below and share view-only access with compliance@lumenixhealth.com. We will raise any last clarifying questions by Feb 7.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdefghLumenixEvidence

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Sarah
